from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's Total Assets data point from a financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company that filed the report")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Assets as reported in the document")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported value, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial statement (e.g., March 31, 2024)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyAssetRecord]
